title: Facebook Public Reshare Time Scraper Input

postUrls.title: Facebook Post URLs
postUrls.description: List of public Facebook post URLs to scrape reshares from.

maxSharesPerPost.title: Max Shares Per Post
maxSharesPerPost.description: Maximum number of public reshares to scrape for each post.

maxScrollAttempts.title: Max Scroll Attempts
maxScrollAttempts.description: Safety threshold on the number of scroll actions inside the reshare dialog to prevent infinite loops.

scrollDelayMs.title: Scroll Delay (ms)
scrollDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between scroll actions to allow lazy GraphQL loading.

timezone.title: Output Timezone
timezone.description: IANA Timezone identifier used to generate human-readable sharedAtLocal values (e.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable verbose logging and save sanitized diagnostic network events.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy configuration to prevent IP rate-limiting on large multi-post runs.

headless.title: Headless Mode
headless.description: Run Chromium in headless mode. Set to false for local visual debugging.

paginationMode.title: Pagination Mode
paginationMode.description: Strategy for paginating reshares: AUTO (hybrid with fallback), HYBRID (direct cursor replay), or UI_SCROLL (browser scroll).
enumTitles: AUTO (Hybrid Replay with UI Scroll Fallback)

maxRunTimeSeconds.title: Max Run Time Per Post (seconds)
maxRunTimeSeconds.description: Optional time limit in seconds per post for scraping reshares.
